$comment: Manual overrides layered on top of the automatic variant merge. Edit freely; the file is read at runtime and never rewritten.
$comment_merge: Force these Fandango movie ids to fold into one entry. Each array is one group; the first id supplies the canonical link.
$comment_split: Block an automatic merge. Each array lists ids that must stay separate even when their titles normalize identically.
$comment_theaterNames: Short display names for the Notes column. Keys match the theater name Fandango renders, case-insensitively.
